messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: {"animals": ["bear", "beetle", "pillbug"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A large four-legged creature standing in profile facing right with the dense shaggy brown fur, head, ears, legs and clawed paws of a brown bear, but covered over the top of the head, neck, back, sides, shoulders and hips with glossy dark brown-black segmented armor like a beetle or pillbug, with a row of oval holes along the lower side plates and a single long smooth curved black horn rising from the top of the head armor and arching forward.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "furry brown bear head with brown eyes, tan muzzle and black nose", "part": "head", "where": "at the front of the body"}, {"looks_like": "long smooth glossy black curved beetle horn tapering to a point", "part": "horn", "where": "on top of the head armor curving forward over the head"}, {"looks_like": "small round furry brown bear ears", "part": "ears", "where": "on top of the head protruding through the head armor"}, {"looks_like": "thick shaggy brown bear legs", "part": "legs", "where": "under the torso, two in front and two in back"}, {"looks_like": "broad furry bear paws with long pale claws", "part": "feet", "where": "at the bottom ends of the legs"}, {"looks_like": "narrow segmented armored tail ending in a tuft of brown fur", "part": "tail", "where": "at the rear of the body extending down from the back plates"}, {"looks_like": "glossy dark brown to black segmented beetle-like armor with oval holes along the lower side", "part": "plates", "where": "covering the top of the head, neck, entire back, sides, shoulders and hips"}, {"looks_like": "dense shaggy brown bear fur with lighter tan on the face", "part": "fur", "where": "covering the face, torso, legs and tail tuft beneath the armor"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "tails": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
